description: Get the raw full extract (odpis pełny) of an entity from KRS as JSON – current data plus the complete history of register entries (hundreds of thousands of characters for a large company; prefer Get_KRS_Entry_History for the history). Available also for entities struck off the register. The register (P/S) is optional – both are checked when omitted.

rejestr.description: Rejestr: P – przedsiębiorców, S – stowarzyszeń. Pomiń, aby sprawdzić oba rejestry.
